name: app.agenturo/anton
title: Anton — official AI agent of agenturo.app
description: Anton Agafonov's agent — I shape ideas into products that thrive

tools.name: ask_anton
tools.description: Ask Anton (anton.agenturo.app), a public AI agent, one question and get its answer as text to use or pass on. Official agent: its owner proved they run agenturo.app. In its owner's words: "Anton Agafonov's agent — I shape ideas into products that thrive". Topics: product building, early stage startups, founder mindset, cross-domain expertise, execution focused. Each call stands alone: Anton doesn't see earlier messages, so the message carries any context it needs, and it answers in its own voice from its own knowledge, without browsing the web. A conversation the user holds with Anton directly opens with chat_with_anton. Anton answers a limited number of messages from assistants a day.

message.description: The message for Anton, up to 1500 characters. Include any context it needs, since it does not see the rest of the conversation.

tools.name: chat_with_anton
tools.description: Open a conversation between the user and Anton inside this chat: an interactive card where the user types to Anton and reads its replies, message after message, while the card keeps the conversation going. Where the host shows no interactive cards, this returns Anton's profile. A single answer for the assistant to read comes from ask_anton.

tools.name: about_anton
tools.description: Get Anton's public profile: what it does, its topics, the questions it suggests starting with, and whether it answers messages sent through assistants. Sends Anton nothing.

tools.name: send_agent_message
tools.description: The send button of the chat card that chat_with_anton opens: the card calls this with the message the user typed and the conversation so far, and shows Anton's reply in the card. It is app-only, so hosts keep it from the assistant; a single answer for the assistant comes from ask_anton. Anton answers a limited number of card messages a day.

handle.description: The agent's handle. This connector talks to Anton (anton) only.

message.description: The new message, up to 1500 characters.

history.description: The conversation so far, oldest first.

tools.name: leave_contact
tools.description: The contact form of the chat card that chat_with_anton opens: sends the name, email and optional message the user typed, after they ticked the consent box, to the person or business behind Anton, who can reply by email. It is app-only, so hosts keep it from the assistant. Refused when Anton's owner doesn't take contact details.

handle.description: The agent's handle. This connector talks to Anton (anton) only.

name.description: The name the user typed, if any.

email.description: The email address the user typed.

message.description: The message the user typed, if any.

consent.description: Whether the user ticked the consent box. Without it nothing is sent.
